description: List the organization's events, latest start date first (up to 200). Use it to find the eventId that every event-scoped tool needs. Returns events[] with eventId, number, name, status, type, start and end dates, timezone, city, isVirtual, and a dashboard url, plus truncated.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_events

number.description: Sequential event number used in app URLs.

status.description: Event status, e.g. draft or published.

type.description: Event type, e.g. conference or meetup.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
